title: REC-C3.3.2 — composition / integration inversion (Tren A)
summary: Tren A closes the capability-bundle split for chronos_domain::ports::execution_log and the consumer migration in chronos-services. ExecutionLogProvider (canonical evidence) becomes a bundle of three independent ports: ExecutionLogProvider (evidence), ExecutionLogRetention (advance_retained_from), and ExecutionLogMaintenance (flush / compact_retired / metrics). SegmentedRetention + SegmentedMaintenance + InMemoryRetention + InMemoryMaintenance live in chronos-log. SessionExecutionLog in chronos-services holds three Arc<dyn ...> ports + provenance dir. ProviderKind enum + try_adopt constructor + take_over_segmented test bypass + ExecutionLogMaintenanceUnsupported ServiceError are all deleted. The closure eliminates the only narrow maintenance escape hatch left from C3.3.1. Plus the anti-stale-waiver ratchet at crates/chronos-services/tests/c33_25_capability_bundle_ratchet.rs (7 tests, validated by RED->GREEN injection on projection.rs) and a checker hygiene commit removing the stale ExecutionLogProviderShape/NoopExecutionLogProvider placeholders from the REC-C3.3 surface assertion. Tren A is local-only at HEAD (35 commits ahead of origin/main) until PR #31 is merged; remote seal happens at merge time. No tag in this cycle (structural inversion; next cycle earns the tag).

scope_decisions: Tren A scope: capability-bundle split (evidence + retention + maintenance) + consumer migration in services + anti-stale-waiver ratchet + checker hygiene. Tren B (C3.3.3) is services -> ports inversion for native + store; Tren B does NOT touch C3.3.2 code.

Tren B does NOT include chronos-store -> chronos-native; that edge belongs to REC-C3.4 per the C3.3.0 exploration report (rec-c3-3-services-inversion/exploration-report.md lines 34, 210, 224) and the C3.3.2 exploration report (line 257). The ledger's last waiver after Tren B will be chronos-store -> chronos-native (C3.4).
No NativeProbeServicePort in Tren B. Existing ports are reused; only widen capabilities if a real use case appears that cannot be expressed by the current surface.

SessionRepository stays lifecycle/registry (no inflation). New ports SessionArchive (save/load/list/delete) and CounterexampleRepository (separate) are introduced for the services -> store inversion; SessionMetadata moves to chronos-domain. Stop rule for Tren B: if removing chronos-store from services/Cargo.toml requires dyn Any / downcast / store helper / chronos_store DTO crossing the port, the inversion is wrong; abort and replan.
Composition root stays in chronos-mcp::composition (not chronos-services::composition). Bootstrap-scoped vs session-scoped factory distinction is mandatory.
smoke_subset: N/A at this Tren A commit. T4 sandbox smoke is intentionally skipped for a structural inversion (no new behavior touched at the wire surface beyond the probe_compaction_metrics tool returning port counters). Tren B will run T4-smoke on representative sandbox suites.

carry_forward_debt.C33-DEBT-NATIVE-LOG-BRIDGE-01: CLOSED in C3.3.1+C3.3.2 — native bridge was retired in commit e48f40cb and the bridge path is no longer reachable through SessionExecutionLog in Tren A.
carry_forward_debt.HEX-002: GAP — closes only after C3.3.3 (Tren B) finishes services -> ports inversion. Tren A removed the maintenance escape hatches and the ProviderKind downcast tag, but the services -> native / services -> store edges are still present in Cargo.toml; those are Tren B scope.
carry_forward_debt.FIND-Tren-A-01: OPEN — pre-existing vault drift in origin/main (CC#18: 9 lines, CC#19: 6 lines, CC#39: 1 line) is out of scope for Tren A. The fix is a separate vault hygiene cycle that mirrors the m9-01..m9-55 cadence; Tren A only fixed the 9 lines of new drift it introduced (the two apply-checkpoint.json files).
carry_forward_debt.FIND-INFRA-DERIVE-SKIP-ARGS-EMPTY: CLOSED — pre-existing bug in scripts/derive_test_buckets.py: empty deferred ledger wrote newline-terminated empty file; awk produced dangling `--skip ` flag, breaking CI with `error: Argument to option 'skip' missing`. Fixed in commit 5d3c9302 (zero-byte skip file when patterns is empty); ratchet test added at scripts/tests/test_derive_test_buckets.py (3 tests, zero deps). Out of strict Tren A scope; included because the CI gate is blocking and the fix is the minimum patch.
